method: ABI adjusted response score; equal-area 300 m overview. Largest soil component per map unit. County assignment uses cell centers; state totals sum county cells. All mapped land uses. Not measured response, crop yield, or cropland acreage.
source: USDA-NRCS Soil Data Access factors; saved FY2026 gSSURGO grid sampled to 300 m, with retired map-unit IDs refreshed from current USDA polygons at exact cell centers

soilIdRefresh.method: Exact intersections of affected 300 m raster cell centers with current USDA Soil Data Access polygons. Uncovered or ambiguous centers stay unavailable. No matching by soil name.
